title: MTH 602 final project / PADataset multi-surrogate DQNGuard
goal: Complete the MTH602/DQNGuard follow-on program with two scientifically separated tracks: (A) repair the published Target–Surrogate control by retraining competent leave-two-out backbones, and (B) develop single-backbone multi-surrogate OSR using a competent target-withheld four-known backbone. In parallel, finish the STFT/time-frequency representation diagnostic for the PA1↔PA4 boundary. Preserve true-target quarantine, known-only selection/threshold semantics, exact provenance, and keep OSR-method changes separate from backbone/representation changes.
acceptance_criteria: Track A remains a control repair: original leave-two-out target/surrogate taxonomy and original DQNGuard evaluator are preserved while backbones are retrained to genuine convergence under known-only selection.

Track B compares Architecture A (pooled DQN), Architecture B (surrogate-specific DQNs with cross-surrogate selection), and Architecture C (hybrid pooled DQN + deterministic guard) on the same competent target-withheld four-known backbone/evidence partitions.
Architecture B excludes the training-surrogate diagonal from selection and selects for off-diagonal transferability; the true target is not consumed until the winner is frozen.
B0=softmax3; B1=matched expanded5 [Pmax,gap,entropy,energy,logit variance]; B2=winning state plus class-conditional bands.
STFT remains a separate representation diagnostic/ablation; existing legacy cache and completed overlay files are preserved.
PA1 legacy-cache resolution is provenance-based/fail-closed; live resume is allowed only after a real PA1 legacy base cache resolves in preflight.
Workspace Shell candidate execution is evidence-only; authoritative PADataset execution remains pinned to befe383fd67c8bca8d8ce370344b33c7e13cd52f.
No merge authority is inferred for PR #17, #21, #23, #636, or this handoff PR.
constraints: Never use true target labels for backbone gradients, DQN fitting, surrogate selection, threshold selection, HPO, retry decisions, or method selection.
Keep disjoint known-fit, known-guard, known-threshold, and pseudo-open roles.
Final thresholds remain known-only at the declared reject budget unless a separately documented method changes that contract.
Track A and Track B stay separate; Track B must not replace the control repair.
Do not interpret seed0/seed1 differences as initialization variance alone because the current seed also changes data partitions and loader order.
Monitor PA1↔PA4 per-class confusion/F1, not aggregate macro-F1 alone.
Do not delete/rebuild the first 120 completed STFT overlay records.
Do not run STFT from /tmp; use persistent exact-SHA checkout under $HOME/adamArchives/worktrees.
Do not widen Workspace Shell task authority to validate candidate code; use candidate-pytest.
